name: mu-explorer
description: Site do MU Explorer (Astro, publicado no Cloudflare Workers com Static Assets). Os scrapers ficam em Python, em scrapers/.

scripts.check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env prod && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env hml
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.deploy:hml: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env hml
scripts.test:site: node --test site/src/lib/planner.test.ts site/src/lib/api.test.ts site/src/lib/taxonomy.test.ts site/src/lib/mapview.test.ts site/src/lib/guides.test.ts
